title: Teenagers charged after alleged gunpoint rape of Sydney woman
text: Teenagers charged after alleged gunpoint rape of Sydney woman Two teenagers, 17 and 18, have been charged after a young woman was allegedly raped at gunpoint in Sydney’s south-west. Two teenagers have been charged after an 18-year-old woman was allegedly sexually assaulted at gunpoint in Sydney’s south-west. A group of three females and two teenage males were in a vehicle near Vine Street, Fairfield, just before 11pm on October 26, when one of the males pulled out a handgun. A woman was found in a park after allegedly being driven in a car from Vine Street, Fairfield, and raped at gunpoint by two teenage males. Two of the females escaped the car, but the third was allegedly driven to another location and sexually assaulted, NSW Police said in a statement.Advertisement Fairfield police and the Sex Crimes squad formed Strikeforce Farabee and, the following day, raided a home at Edensor Park and seized a gel-blaster shaped like a Glock pistol. A 17-year-old boy was arrested and taken to Cabramatta Police Station where he was charged with possess unauthorised firearm, and three counts of intimidation. He was refused bail by police but released by a children’s court magistrate on bail. He will return to court next week.He was taken to Cabramatta Police Station where he was charged with stalk\/intimidate intend fear physical harm and possess unauthorised firearm. The pair were re-arrested on Friday and charged again. The boy was charged with aggravated sexual assault in company while threatening actual bodily harm by weapon, and four counts of aggravated sex assault in company and again refused bail by police.The man was charged with four counts of aggravated sex assault in company, domestic violence choking, and aggravated sexual assault in company while threatening actual bodily harm by weapon. Support is available from the National Sexual Assault, Domestic Family Violence Counselling Service at 1800RESPECT or the Men’s Referral Service on 1300 766 491.
